mechanics.original_reminder: Exile the top three cards of your library face up. Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to an opponent, put a journeyed card you own into your hand.
mechanics.executable_reminder: Exile the top card of your library face up. Give it the journeyed status while in exile. Register a persistent rule named "journey retrieval" for you with event condition "You own a card in exile with the journeyed status" and ability "Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to an opponent, put a card you own in exile with the journeyed status into your hand."

rule_text.name: 701.79a
rule_text.rule: Journey is a keyword action. To journey, exile the top card of your library face up and it becomes journeyed.

rule_text.name: 701.79b
rule_text.rule: There is an inherent triggered ability associated with owning journeyed cards in exile. This triggered ability has no source and is controlled by the player whose creature triggered it. The full text of this ability is “Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to an opponent, put a journeyed card you own from exile into your hand.”

rule_text.name: 701.79c
rule_text.rule: The triggered ability will trigger once for each creature that dealt combat damage, regardless of how many journeyed cards that player owns in exile.
